v = mod.get_run(s, "r1").version
assert {:ok, r} = mod.transition(s, "r1", [:pending], :waiting, %{})
assert r.status == :waiting and r.version == v + 1
assert {:error, :stale} = mod.transition(s, "r1", [:pending], :completed, %{})
assert {:error, :illegal} = mod.transition(s, "r1", :any, :cancelled, %{})
assert {:error, :not_found} = mod.transition(s, "zz", :any, :failed, %{})
assert {:ok, %{result: 42}} = mod.transition(s, "r1", :any, :completed, %{result: 42})
assert {:error, :stale} = mod.transition(s, "r1", :any, :failed, %{})
assert mod.get_run(s, "r1").status == :completed
assert mod.get_run(s, "r1").result == 42
rows.statement: transition applies only from an allowed status: ok bumps version, stale, illegal, not_found; terminal is absorbing
